en: Wanna come on up? Not that there's a roof.
Well, drop by any time you like.
Not like I've got anything else to do.
You poor man. Please, take this.
But do you not work at all?
Lay out the mat, sit by the road... all set.
Right, open for business. Spare a coin, please!
So there are beggars in London too.
It isn't much, but please take it.
Here, it isn't much, but take it.
Oh, it's you... Very well.
Taken that much of a shine to me, have ya?
You again... Oh, very well.
Here, it isn't much.
Ah, I'd love to go somewhere far away.
Wouldn't it be nice to travel, eh?
Spare me a little something, won't ya?
Well, well, guv'nor, a home visit, is it?
Mind you, there's nothing to offer you here.
Hey there, guv'nor. Need something?
Which means you've come to spare me something, eh?
Even a man like this might be of some use.
note: Player speaking (gentle register), before draining Wally.

en: Wally, I'm sorry.
I must borrow your strength
What the
I wonder if he'll really be of any use
Your orders...
note: after #0 ', my master...': starts a new sentence.

en: That killer folks round here keep talking about,
Jack the Ripper... You heard of him?
Heh heh heh.
See, I know who the Ripper really is.
Say, you'd like to know too, wouldn't ya?
Who Jack the Ripper really is...
I'm an information broker, see.
And good info's worth good money.
Oh, it's you.
Heard anything interesting?
Look, just trust what I'm telling ya.
Hey, this ain't really the place to talk.
Let's leave it for another time.
Ah, it's you.
Well, if you wanna talk, let's do it at the pub.
Standing around chatting in a place like this,
we stick out like a sore thumb...
If you want to hear the whole story,
come by the pub.
This here's my secret hideout, No. 1.
I'd rather not draw attention, see,
so be a pal and clear off.
Sorry, but I'd rather you didn't come round
here looking for me so much.
If you wanna talk, let's do it at the pub.
Well, come on in.
I'm about ready to say goodbye to this dump
and move to a new place to hole up.
So you've come calling at a fella's home.
Brought a little gift at least, I hope?
I ain't lying to you, y'know.
I really do know where Jack
is hiding out, I swear!
You're interested in Jack, ain't ya?
That murderer, Jack the Ripper?
Do you truly know something?
Course I do.
(Something about him smells fishy...)
Whoa, you're a persistent one, ain't ya.
Here about Jack again today?
Well, being in the information trade,
as long as I get paid, I just might
tell ya what I know.
Money, is it?
I can provide as much of that as you wish.
Oho. Spoken like a rich man.
Mighty generous of ya.
Right, go and get 900 pounds together.
Then I'll tell ya.
Good, you've brought the money.
All right, I'll tell ya.
